phone.title: Check your phone
phone.description: Enter the 6-digit code we texted to {{phone}}. One phone number can only have one AutoSouk account.

face.introDescription: Record a short video of your face while you follow 4 quick instructions. An AutoSouk admin checks it by hand.

tips.time: About 1 minute, with the front camera
tips.light: Good light, face uncovered, no sunglasses or cap
tips.privacy: Only AutoSouk admins see the video. We delete it after the check.

face.consent: I agree that AutoSouk records my face video and checks it against my account.
face.consentRequired: Tick the box to agree first.
face.cameraBlocked: We can't use your camera. Allow it in your browser settings, then try again.
face.noRecorder: Your browser can't record video. Try another browser.
face.cameraDescription: Keep your face inside the oval. Recording stops by itself after the last step.
face.reviewDescription: Watch it once: your face must be clear in every step.
face.uploadingDescription: Keep this page open until it's done. It takes a few seconds.
face.uploadFailed: The video didn't arrive. Check your connection and send it again.
face.pendingDescription: An AutoSouk admin reviews it by hand, usually within 24 hours. We'll email you when it's done.
face.whileYouWaitDescription: You can browse and save cars. Selling and inspections open once you're verified.
face.rejectedDescription: Your account stays limited until a face video is approved. Record it again in good light.
face.noAttempts: You have used all your attempts. Contact support to verify your identity.
face.whileYouWaitMechanic: Send your documents now: an admin checks them with your video, so buyers can book you sooner.

banner.actionDescription: Check your phone and record a short face video to sell, buy inspections and inspect cars.
banner.pendingDescription: Usually within 24 hours. You can browse in the meantime.
banner.rejectedDescription: Record your face video again to unlock all of AutoSouk.

required.title: Verify your identity first
required.description: To keep AutoSouk safe, selling, inspections and reviews open once your phone and face video are checked.

account.title: Identity & security
account.description: Who you are on AutoSouk and how your account is protected.
